install_steps: Or: curl -Lo talosctl https://github.com/siderolabs/talos/releases/latest/download/talosctl-linux-amd64 && chmod +x talosctl && sudo mv talosctl /usr/local/bin
note: talosctl talks to nodes over a mutual-TLS gRPC API (port 50000) — no SSH. Node/context selection comes from ~/.talos/config (talosctl config context). `talosctl cluster create` needs Docker or QEMU locally and is the fastest way to get a real Talos+k8s cluster for testing.
